verdict.rationale: INPI's filing docs explicitly recognize "mandataires" (representatives) as a class of users who file formalities for clients. A bulk payment modality is aimed at declarants and mandataires doing high volumes, and a payment-delegation mode lets a mandataire pass the fee to its client. This shows a sanctioned representative rail exists, but it appears only in payment context, with no documentation of how a representative is authorized or bound to the company. Missing for 10: documented mandate/pouvoir requirements for representatives, how a company designates or revokes a provider, the scope of what a mandataire may file or sign, and independent corroboration.
